name: Cupertino Leaders in Training (LIT)
org: City of Cupertino, Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Volunteer at city summer camps next to city staff. You help lead camp activities and supervise younger kids, and you get training and weekly feedback.
who_can_apply: Teens who will be at least 14 by the first day of in-service training. The page describes it as a program for Cupertino teens. No other residency or school rule is stated.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer role. The page says payment is collected after you are accepted, and your spot can be taken back if fees are not paid on time. The fee amount is not stated on the page.
duration: Volunteers are encouraged to help for 4 to 8 weeks in the summer, after a required in-service training week.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026 closed on Friday, March 27, 2026. The page says the next application opens in February 2027. The 2027 closing date is not posted yet.
how_to_apply: The form opens in February. It has a few extra questions. Staff pick teens by their answers, a talk with staff, and the weeks they are free. If you get in, you get a TB test and fingerprints, pay the fee, and sign forms. Ask Robert Kaufman: robertk@cupertino.gov.
notes: You must attend the in-service training week and get yourself to and from program sites. Program assignments come out in late May. The 2027 dates are based on last year's pattern. The page does not list the fee, so ask before you apply.
